checks.name: step_order
checks.detail: expected per well: beads > isopropanol > sample > remove > ethanol > remove > ethanol > remove > elution > recover

checks.name: fresh_tip_per_sample_no_cross_contact
checks.detail: 48 distinct tips for 48 sample transfers; violations: []

items.evidence: Checks show 48 tubes to 48 distinct odd-column wells, 48 distinct tips, 48 distinct elution wells; p1000 uses a fresh tip per sample.
Code dispenses 40 uL beads, then 250 uL isopropanol, then 250 uL sample with mix(5,...), then a 5 min delay, magnet engage plus 4 min delay, then 540 uL removal to waste; all checks pass.
add_ethanol/remove_supernatant run twice with 500 uL while the magnet is engaged, then a 4 min delay and magdeck.disengage(); checks two_500ul_ethanol_washes and air_dry_4min pass.
ELUATE_VOL = 95 uL is recovered, not about 80 uL, which leaves only 5 uL behind and risks bead carryover; the 100 uL elution, 90 s magnet and 4 C plate are otherwise correct.
Step order matches the paper and reagent labels are accurate (70% ethanol); the only additions are a minor bead-suspension mix in the reservoir and the elution mix.

judge.summary: The protocol passes all 16 run-log checks and matches the paper for sample handling, binding, washes, and drying. I scored elution_recovery 0 because it recovers 95 uL instead of about 80 uL, though the elution volume, 90 s magnet step and 4 C plate are correct.
